capabilities: Mirror Feishu/Lark wiki and Drive documents into the vault as Markdown
Convert docx and legacy doc content and localize images and attachments
Scan wiki trees and Drive folders recursively and sync on startup or a 15/30/60-minute schedule
Resolve conflicts between locally edited managed regions and remote versions
Manage sources, progress, retries and recovery through a Sync Center
disambiguation: Pulls Feishu/Lark documents into the vault read-only; it does not push local notes back to Feishu or Lark.
extras: Requires the user's own Feishu/Lark application with read-only scopes and a separately installed official lark-cli; Sheet, Base, Slides and Mindnote files are discovered but not converted, and the plugin is desktop-only.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull Feishu/Lark wiki and Drive documents into a vault or keep them updated as local Markdown.

relations.evidence: Use requires a Feishu/Lark account, your own application and a separately installed official lark-cli.

requires.name: Feishu/Lark account with a user-created app
App Secret passed to lark-cli via stdin

summary: Desktop-only plugin that mirrors Feishu and Lark documents into a local vault as Markdown with scheduled, conflict-protected synchronization.
